items.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products

SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM sales_history

SELECT p.name, SUM(sh.revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM sales_history sh
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = sh.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(sh.revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM sales_history sh
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = sh.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_id, r.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY product_count DESC

SELECT name, lead_time_days, reliability_score
FROM suppliers
ORDER BY lead_time_days DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(reliability_score) AS average_reliability_score
FROM suppliers

SELECT SUM(sh.units_sold) AS total_units_sold
FROM sales_history sh
WHERE sh.sale_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS stockout_risk_count
FROM inventory i
WHERE i.snapshot_month = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_month) FROM inventory)
  AND (i.units_on_hand <= i.reorder_point OR i.units_on_hand < i.safety_stock)

SELECT SUM(forecast_units) AS total_forecasted_demand
FROM demand_forecasts

SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(sh.units_sold) AS total_units_sold
FROM sales_history sh
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = sh.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_id, r.name
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT category, AVG(unit_price) AS average_unit_price

GROUP BY category
ORDER BY average_unit_price DESC
